create_identity_transformation: create an IdentityTransformation with format_image=True to build a transformation tree that formats images
build_identity_transformation_tree: build an IdentityTransformation tree that applies load, crop, and tensor conversion to input images
use_load_or_convert_to_image: use load_or_convert_to_image to convert a file path, tensor, or numpy array into a PIL Image
use_crop_if_not_square: use crop_if_not_square to resize and center-crop a PIL Image to a square shape
review_identity_transformation_class: review the IdentityTransformation class and its build_tree method for transformation pipeline logic
